description: Photo prompt tag dictionary for random Korean/English prompt generation. Version 1.7 expands ReactorPrompt export-inspired photo presets across Korean traditional, wuxia/hanfu, cosplay, K-pop, social selfie, local Korean spaces, craft/product, seasonal, transport, and optical-experiment photography while keeping poster, infographic, sticker, UI, and illustration-only layouts out of the photo preset surface.
